page.layout: Two-column page with running head at top. Left margin holds notes beside the first lines of the text column (Demetrius ob reginę stuprum sæstus etc.; Beronices virginis regiæ prudentia). Main text in one column at right of the margins, justified. Page number at top left, running head at top centre.; One printed page: at the top a running title and heading block at full width; below it a block of summary lines with side numbers at the right; a large initial paragraph with a marginal note column at the left; a few short lines of text at the foot. Numbers 15, 20, 25, 30 stand in the right margin.

main_text.p: {a}adulasset, fiducia pulchritudinis, qua nimis placere socrui cœperat, statim à principio superbus, regiæ famili-lia, militibusque impotens erat; studiumque placendi à virgine in matrem contulerat. Quæ res suspecta primo virgini, dein popularibus militibusq;, inuisa fuit. Itaq; svestis omnium animis in Ptolemaï filium, insidiæ Demetrio comparantur; cui cum in lectum socrus concessisset, percussores immittuntur. Sed Arsinoë audita voce filiæ, ad fores stantis & præcipientis vt matri parceretur, adulterum paulisper corpore suo protexit. Quo 1Demetrius ob reginę stuprum sæstus{b} interfecto, Beronice, & slupra matris, salua pietate, vlta est, & in matrimonio sortiendo, iudicium patris secuta.
main_text.head: POMPEII TROGI EPI- TOMA HISTORIARVM LIBER XXVII.
BREVIARIVM.
main_text.p: 1 Seleucus nouercam & ocho Hierace petit & im- fratrem infantē interficit. petrat.
2 Classe naufragio amis- sa,ciuitates amissas recipit: Antiochum Hieracem & prælio victus aufugit: auxi- lium noxium à fratre Anti- 25ocho.
3 Asiæ lacerus status. In Seleucum Numinis vindi- cta.
